children: Aytu BioPharma reported fiscal 2026 full-year net revenue of $57.6 million, down from $66.4 million a year earlier, and fourth-quarter net revenue of $16.1 million, up 6.4% year-over-year. The company recorded a fourth-quarter Adjusted EBITDA of $0.5 million and a full-year Adjusted EBITDA loss of $3.7 million while reporting a cash balance of $26.3 million at June 30, 2026. EXXUA, launched commercially in mid-December 2025 with full sales deployment by late February 2026, generated $3.9 million in Q4 and $6.6 million for the fiscal year.
Net revenue: $57.6 million for fiscal 2026; fourth-quarter net revenue $16.1 million (up 6.4% vs. Q4 2025).
Gross profit: $36.8 million for fiscal 2026, representing 64.0% of net revenue; Q4 gross profit $10.4 million (64.6% of net revenue).
Operating loss (loss from operations): $(8.3) million for fiscal 2026; Q4 loss from operations $(0.8) million.
Net loss: $(14.3) million for fiscal 2026; Q4 net loss approximately break-even at less than $(0.1) million.
Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP): $(3.7) million for fiscal 2026; Q4 Adjusted EBITDA $0.5 million.
EXXUA commercial launch: Made commercially available mid-December 2025 with formal launch in mid-January 2026 after sales training and full sales force deployment in late February.

EXXUA momentum: Generated $3.9 million in Q4 and $6.6 million for fiscal 2026; Q4 prescriptions for EXXUA totaled 3,323, up ~138% from the prior quarter, with monthly scripts reaching a record 1,261 in June.

ADHD portfolio dynamics: ADHD portfolio net revenue was $45.8 million for fiscal 2026 and $10.4 million in Q4; company prioritized EXXUA commercialization and reduced promotion on ADHD brands amid generic competition.
Pediatric portfolio: Fiscal 2026 net revenue of $5.1 million and Q4 net revenue of $1.8 million; Q4 improvement followed normalization of product availability after a prior supply disruption.

Commercial execution focus: Company invested in promotional materials, consulting, sales force and national speaker programs to support EXXUA adoption while leveraging legacy brands for cash generation during the launch phase.
